content: ऐश्वर {%a.%} [ईश्वर-अण्] (री|{%f.%}) .²1 Belonging to or produced by a lord or the Supreme Being, majestic. पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् <ls>Bg. 9. 5</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">11. 3</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 11.">9</ls>. .²2 Powerful, mighty. .²3 Belonging to Śiva; ऐश्वरं धनुरभाजि यत्त्वया <ls>R. 11. 76</ls>. .²4 Supreme, royal. .²5 Divine. .{@-रम्@} Supremacy, power; एकान्तधाम यशसः श्रिय ऐश्वरस्य <ls>Bhāg. 10. 44. 13</ls>. .{@-री@} <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā.
